title: Events
for: webinars and events: registrants, attendees and recordings, joined to the funnel in data/events

manual.export: export registrants and attendees from the webinar tool as CSV (one row per person, with the event name, registration time, and attended yes/no)

vendors.name: Livestorm
caveats: the vendor page says tools cover events, sessions, people and more without an enumerated list; the survey read it as read-only; if the tool list shows a create or update tool, deny the whole server (`mcp__livestorm`) until reviewed
the hosted Claude connector needs Claude.ai Team or Enterprise; the .mcp.json route does not
endpoint read on the vendor developer page today; the survey marks it as a secondary listing

auth.where: browser grant on first use (OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration)

vendors.name: Zoom (Webinars and Meetings)
caveats: write tool names not verified; deny the whole server (`mcp__zoom`) until checked
auth and admin requirements are not documented in the registry repo; verify in the Zoom App Marketplace on the day you wire it
webinar-specific tools (registrants, attendance) are not confirmed; the Workspace server is documented for summaries, transcripts and recordings
more servers on the same host: `/mcp/meeting/streamable`, `/mcp/docs/streamable`, `/mcp/chat/streamable`, `/mcp/tasks/streamable`
already a known route in integrations/adding-an-integration.md; the unattended transcript pull is its worked example (a Server-to-Server OAuth script)
not in the Claude connectors directory

auth.where: browser grant on first use; a Zoom admin may need to approve the app
